tables.name: Alternate Entries
tables.description: Other ways into the fortress. Decide where one is once the rest of the fortress is built.

results.name: None
results.description: There are no alternate entries into the fortress.

results.name: Back Door, Blocked
results.description: A small, rear-access door was built into the exterior wall. For security reasons, it has been blocked from the inside.

results.name: Back Door, Exposed
results.description: A small, rear-access door was built into the exterior wall. The door may still be in regular use, and no attempt has been made to disguise or conceal it. It may be guarded.

results.name: Back Door, Hidden
results.description: A small, rear-access door was built into the exterior wall. The door may be used infrequently, and has been intentionally obscured or covered. It may also be guarded.

results.name: Secret Door in Exterior Wall
results.description: A hidden, or invisible, door is built into the exterior wall, to allow for covert comings and goings. It is probably monitored, but discreetly.

results.name: Secret Door in Exterior Wall, Forgotten
results.description: A hidden, or invisible, door was built into the exterior wall, to allow for covert comings and goings, but those who built and/or knew about it are no longer around.

results.name: Drain, with Grating
results.description: A drain pipe emerges somewhere in the landscape outside the fortress. Its opening is covered by metal grating.

results.name: Drain, Blocked
results.description: A drain pipe emerges somewhere in the landscape outside the fortress. Its final several yards are entirely filled with large stones to allow water to easily pass, but not intruders.

results.name: Drain, Blocked, with Grating
results.description: A drain pipe emerges somewhere in the landscape outside the fortress. Its final several yards are entirely filled with large stones to allow water to easily pass, but not intruders. Its mouth is also covered with metal grating.

results.name: Old, Forgotten Tunnel
results.description: A tunnel was dug out of the fortress quite some time ago, but has since fallen into disrepair. There is a possibility that no one knows about it. Use of the tunnel might risk collapse or cave-in.

results.name: Maintained Tunnel
results.description: A tunnel leads out of the fortress, which is well-maintained and in good repair. It shows signs of recent (but not heavy) use.
